subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): re-export StatusSummary, SessionStatus, and HeartbeatStatus from command-status

question: Should third-party plugins receive the full transitive host `StatusSummary`/`SessionStatus`/`HeartbeatStatus` shapes, or narrower plugin-facing status DTOs?
rationale: The direct exports reach multiple evolving host subsystems, and repository policy requires maintainers to intentionally choose the permanent public compatibility boundary.

options.title: Publish narrow status DTOs
options.body: Expose only fields plugins need and OpenClaw is prepared to preserve across releases.

options.title: Accept the full host graph
options.body: Approve the direct re-exports and own compatibility for all reachable nested types.

options.title: Defer until gateway access lands
options.body: Wait for the related plugin gateway-access API and response semantics before publishing these types.

recommendation.title: Publish narrow status DTOs
recommendation.body: Expose only fields plugins need and OpenClaw is prepared to preserve across releases.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current status type module and command-status SDK boundary in the same current-main commit.
